summary_en: 124,100 shares acquired YTD at ¥270.6M (1.77% of ex-treasury shares). Authorized program: 200,000 shares (2.86% S/O) up to ¥500M over May 2026–Mar 2027. Method: ToSTNeT-3 and open-market buy on TSE.
title_en: Notice Regarding Open-Market Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief:
Yoshicon Co., Ltd. filed a progress notice on 3 August 2026 regarding its authorized open-market share buyback program. The company reports cumulative acquisitions of 124,100 shares for ¥270.6M as of 31 July 2026, executed via ToSTNeT-3 (off-market auction) and open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

The authorized program, approved by the board on 30 April 2026, permits acquisition of up to 200,000 ordinary shares (2.86% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥500M. The execution window runs from 1 May 2026 through 31 March 2027. The July 2026 reporting period shows no purchases in that month alone (0 shares, ¥0), suggesting all 124,100 shares and ¥270.6M in aggregate spending occurred in May–June 2026. Computed pct_so for cumulative acquisitions to date: 124,100 ÷ 7,000,000 shares ex-treasury = 1.77%, rounded to 1.8%.
